review_comment: Creating a new class, such as RocksDBConsumeQueueDoubleWriteMessageStore, and then inheriting from DefaultMessageStore.java, and overriding some methods instead of modifying the original DefaultMessageStore, would be better?
把双写理解为DefaultMessageStore的一个小功能，而不是一个独立的MessageStore，这样更简单一点
Why not use idiomatic equals override approach?
尽量减少影响，降低风险，重写CqUnit的equea影响比较大
降低什么影响， 有什么风险， 说说清楚
这个有什么问题吗
rocksdb相关的测试在mac都跳过了，github提供的mac环境有问题
Add log here to clarify where you have loaded the final consumerOffset.
Batching without timeout is an obvious bug. Instead of add a configuration to walk around this bug, please fix it directly.

Actually, batching here does NOT improve performance at all. Building consume queue in RocksDB has WAL disabled with atomic flush feature on. Put KV into RocksDB actually means insert into MemTable without incurring any IO. Given that all ops are memory-only, batching here is not necessary at all.

其实是的，刚发现这个问题时我有点不太确定，为了防止对原有逻辑产生影响，这里加了一个开关。我先在预发测一下看看，没问题的话这里的batch可以直接去掉

Actually, yes, when I first discovered this issue, I was a bit unsure. To prevent any impact on the original logic, I added a switch here. I'll test it in the pre-release environment first, and if there are no issues, the batch here can be removed directly.
Should add log here.
persistOffset and updateDataVersion should be in the same writeBatch, ensuring change is atomic. It looks not mandatory now, but it is idiomatic to have.

这里不原子应该也没问题，只要updateDataVersion在persist之后就可以，最差的情况是原模原样重新导入一次
It should be fine even if this is not atomic, as long as updateDataVersion occurs after persist. In the worst-case scenario, it would just require re-importing in the same state.

I said not mandatory, but keeping data and version consistent is really good to have, especially when you are trouble shooting bugs online.

IMO, it will be a minor change to achieve this goal. Why not?
Need a comment, explaining why maxOffset -1 makes sense here.
这里应该是之前写错了，不-1拿不到最新的cqUnit，这块和别的ConsumeQueue实现保持一致了
Add log here.
The reason should be explained
This implies this PR won't build CQ records into RocksDB CQ store for existing messages in commit log if they are previously indexed by file-based CQ store.
Config will be error prune. Once config of existing classic nodes are changed inappropriately, things will be totally messed up

是这样的，需要按照issuse里边的配置来进行原地升级，如果直接改storeType，旧的消息将消费不到了，cq升级有俩种方案，一种是broker启动的时候做转换，一种是双写一段时间然后切流，我们选择了后者，这里的原因在issue里边有写，为了稳定性和不阻塞broker启动考虑的

Yes, it is necessary to perform an in-place upgrade according to the configuration in the issue. If you directly change the storeType, old messages will not be consumable. There are two solutions for upgrading the consume queue (CQ): one is to perform the conversion when the broker starts, and the other is to double-write for a period of time and then switch the flow. We chose the latter, as explained in the issue, for reasons of stability and to avoid blocking the broker startup.
Then it's necessary to add a check and abort logic to guard against this incident from happening.
when dataVersion update? the dataVersion only changes during the HA switch
没有的，offset的刷新有个步长，满足步长也会刷新的
